payload.title: Engagement page: the three offers are examples, not a menu
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-09-26: /engage made it look like Anthus only does three things. Reframed: intro invites any problem AI might solve even when the client can't say what they need; the three become 'examples of where we start' with a line saying they aren't a menu; the first-month pilot includes a discovery month that ends with a scoped proposal; the closing line asks for the problem even if half-formed.
